Thanks again for the demo last week. We’re excited about Redwood’s runtime for our consulting engagements. Before we proceed to a pilot commitment, our commercial ops team needs clarity on two items we track tightly with our clients:

1) Prospect ownership / first-touch crediting — how long does BridgePoint get registration protection after we submit a lead (and what counts as a valid registration)?
2) Commission/payment flow — we typically run a 60-day trial with a small rebate triggered on activation + milestone. Do you support trial rebates / milestone credits in your partner payout model?

Great to connect. Short answers up front:
- Registration protection: we offer a 90-day claim window from the date a partner registers a lead in our portal; valid registrations require: company name, point-of-contact email, and the expected ARR band. If BridgePoint needs longer we can discuss extensions for strategic deals.
- Trial rebate / milestone credits: supported. We handle these as a rebate ledger entry tied to the deal id; finance issues partner payouts 30 days after the milestone invoice clears.

Proposed next steps:
- Marissa (cc’d) can confirm the commission band and whether this will be referral (one-time) or revenue-share (recurring) for the pilot.
- Logan — can you confirm whether the registration portal record you saw supports importing BridgePoint’s CSV export? If not, we can accept HubSpot deal links as interim evidence.

I’ll book 30 minutes for tomorrow at 10:30 PT if that works for you.

Thanks,

Thanks Naomi — adding some detail from partner ops side.

BridgePoint is eligible for two crediting paths depending on the engagement type:

A) Referral (intro-based):
- One-time referral fee equal to 7% of first-year recognized ARR.
- Registration protection: 90 days from portal registration.
- Validations: we need a screenshot or HubSpot deal link + email thread showing intro.

B) Revenue share (co-sell / embed):
- Revenue share tiers: Pilot (0–$50k ARR): 15% net revenue share; Scale tiers negotiated separately.
- Rebate/milestone support: we can implement an upfront trial rebate as a negative invoice line item; Redwood Finance requires a signed SOW that references the rebate schedule.

Operational asks for BridgePoint:
- Please fill out the attached commission matrix (BridgePoint_CommMatrix_v1.xlsx) with expected deal cadence and preferred payout cadence (monthly/quarterly).
- For CSV import: Logan can accept a CSV with these columns: prospect_company | poc_email | date_submitted | estimated_arr | supporting_link. If your ops team uses HubSpot, include the deal URL in supporting_link.

Naomi — I’ll own setting up the partner record and the initial payout band. Samir — confirm whether BridgePoint will treat the pilot as referral or revenue-share. If referral, payouts are faster; revenue-share requires an MSA addendum.

– Marissa Cole
